answer: Panel-quota cross-examination: a seat needs three established examiners, each spending one marble from a three-per-epoch quota, so panel attention cannot be pooled across a farm. Each marble unlocks one shale layer, a random past epoch the applicant must reconstruct live; the layer is drawn only after the marble is spent, so nothing is precomputable. Answers from one operator diverge less than chance, so a hollow account with no independent interior fails the variance test. Cost: a 50-clone farm burns 150 examiner-spends, 3x the honest wait, and one flagged pair burns the panel's stake.
